import torch

from ogb.linkproppred import LinkPropPredDataset
dataset = LinkPropPredDataset(name='ogbl-biokg', root='data/ogbl-biokg')  # already downloaded+processed at this root

data.summary:
DATASET: ogbl-biokg (Open Graph Benchmark, OGB), a large biomedical KNOWLEDGE GRAPH; release v1.
A multi-relational, heterogeneous graph of directed (head, relation, tail) triples. The full graph was re-fetched and processed via OGB into the cache at root='data/ogbl-biokg' (the previous local biokg.zip was truncated); the 5M triples are NOT copied into this case -- load them from that cache with the recipe below. The CSVs under data/mapping/ are the REAL entity/relation vocabularies (a small pointer).
VERIFIED COUNTS (from the loaded graph, not invented):
  NODES: 93,773 total across 5 entity types -- drug=10533 (STITCH IDs, e.g. CID000000001), protein=17499 (Entrez Gene IDs), disease=10687 (UMLS CUIs), sideeffect=9969 (UMLS CUIs), function=45085 (Gene Ontology IDs).
  RELATIONS: 51 relation types (see data/mapping/relidx2relname.csv), e.g. disease-protein, drug-disease, drug-protein, drug-sideeffect, protein-function, function-function, many drug-drug_<disease-context> and protein-protein_<mechanism> (activation/binding/catalysis/expression/inhibition/ptmod/reaction).
  TRIPLES: 5,088,434 total, split train=4,762,678 / valid=162,886 / test=162,870. dataset[0]['edge_index_dict'] carries the 4,762,678 training edges; get_edge_split() gives valid/test.
HOW TO LOAD THE FULL GRAPH (Python, ogb installed):
import torch
_orig = torch.load
torch.load = lambda *a, **k: _orig(*a, **{**k, 'weights_only': False})  # REQUIRED: ogb caches with torch.save; torch>=2.6 defaults weights_only=True and fails on the cache
from ogb.linkproppred import LinkPropPredDataset
dataset = LinkPropPredDataset(name='ogbl-biokg', root='data/ogbl-biokg')  # already downloaded+processed at this root
graph = dataset[0]           # dict: edge_index_dict[(head_type,rel,tail_type)]=(2,E), edge_reltype, num_nodes_dict
split = dataset.get_edge_split()   # {'train','valid','test'}; each has head,relation,tail,head_type,tail_type
